asked.item: Should I uncheck the messaging permission to get past the 'isn't eligible' error
Two DM automations live on the account

verdict.reason: The Instagram page says unchecking messaging excludes DM automations, including live ones, and says to escalate instead of removing it.

steps.text: Unchecking the messaging permission only attempts publishing-only authorization, and it does not guarantee eligibility.
It also excludes the messaging permission that DM automations need, including any automation already live on the account.
If you have live DM automations, the page says not to silently remove this permission and to escalate the eligibility error.
